audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose was correct at EVEN 5.5/10 but was written for a male enemy throughout, and the packet flags that the matchup 'never names any of Lissandra's abilities'.
audit.why: 52.74% over 749 games is an even lane. The reader could not act on prose that never said Ice Shard, Ring of Frost, Glacial Path or Frozen Tomb.
audit.corrected: Kept the rating; every rewritten field now names the ability and its range or cooldown. Pronouns corrected throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Skill on rows 0, 1, 3 and 6 while win[0], win[1], win[3] and win[6] all read Cassiopeia and the packet levelChart agrees with the content layer.
audit.why: The kit backs the content layer on those rows: Ice Shard is 725 to your 850 and Ring of Frost only reaches 450, so levels 1-2 and 4-5 are Cassiopeia's, and two items of poison beats a burst-and-peel kit. Rows 2 and 4 stay Skill — Glacial Path into Ice Shard is a genuine level 3 all-in, and Frozen Tomb at 6 turns her untargetable through your commit.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0], [1], [3] and [6] to Cassiopeia, with whys rewritten on the two that were generic. win[N] already holds these values on disk so there is no paired content edit to propose — before would equal after — and after these edits all seven rows agree across both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four content fields claim Frozen Tomb grants CC immunity that lets her 'walk straight through Miasma and Q poison', and two claim Glacial Path 'applies a slow to herself'. Riot's text supports neither: self-cast Frozen Tomb makes her untargetable and invulnerable while healing, and Glacial Path is a damaging claw she can reactivate to teleport to. Nothing about self-slow, nothing about CC immunity.
audit.why: A player who believes she is CC-immune will not use Miasma or Petrifying Gaze on her at all, which throws away the two spells that actually beat her.
audit.corrected: Replaced all of it with what the kit does say: untargetable and invulnerable while it heals, so wait it out instead of dumping the combo into it, and bring Grievous Wounds because it heals. Added the interaction that was missing entirely — Miasma grounds the Glacial Path reactivation, stranding her where the claw landed.

audit.why: Glacial Path's cooldown halves across ranks, which changes how large the punish window is.
audit.corrected: Glacial Path 24 to 12, Ring of Frost 10s at 450 range, Frozen Tomb 120/100/80 against your identical R cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim, dontsFull[1].d carried the anti-dive Miasma line under a title about her rotation (lint).
audit.why: Bodies did not answer their titles.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the titles, using Twin Fang's flat 40 mana and her Ring of Frost into Frozen Tomb chain.

edits.before: Lissandra's E applies a slow to herself that pairs with Q for a solid trade tool, so respect her all-in potential from level 2 onward rather than standing still in Miasma range. That said, she has no ranged poke outside Q, so you can out-trade her in straight pokes if you dodge her E timing. Watch her jungler — her E's self-slow makes her briefly vulnerable but the root on hit also enables ganks. Play the poke war patiently; her kit is burst-reliant and runs dry between cooldowns.
edits.after: Lissandra's Glacial Path claw pairs with Ice Shard for a real trade tool, so respect her all-in from level 2 onward rather than standing still in Ring of Frost range. She has no ranged poke outside Q at 725, so you out-trade her in straight pokes from 850 if you watch the claw. Watch her jungler — the 450-range root is what turns a gank into a kill on an immobile Cassiopeia. Play the poke war patiently; her kit is burst-reliant and runs dry between cooldowns.

edits.before: Level 3 is close since her E-Q combo threatens real burst damage if she catches you mid-poke, so play a touch safer through that window. Levels 4-5 swing back to you as your poison ramp starts outpacing her cooldown-limited burst. Level 6 is her scariest spike — R grants CC immunity, letting her walk straight through Miasma and Q poison to land her claw-stun combo without being punished for it, so avoid committing your own all-in during that window. After the ult is down, she has nothing left to punish your poke.

Level 6 is her scariest spike — Frozen Tomb on herself makes her untargetable and invulnerable while it heals her, so a combo dumped into that window is simply deleted; hold it. Once the 120-second ult is down she has nothing left to punish your poke.

notes: Two fabricated mechanics were on this page and both are now removed: Frozen Tomb was described as granting CC immunity that lets her walk through Miasma (Riot's text says untargetable and invulnerable while healing — nothing about CC), and Glacial Path was described as self-slowing (Riot's text has no self-slow). I did not replace them with any claim about whether grounding or Petrifying Gaze can affect her during the untargetable window — the kits do not say, and it is recorded in unverified. The full-layer chart was moved onto the content/packet chart on four rows; win[N] already matched, so no paired content edits exist to write.
